# Set-up
```{r}

set.seed(42)

cran_packages <- c("knitr", "lme4", "ggeffects", "tidyverse", "here", "emmeans")

missing_cran <- setdiff(cran_packages, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) {
  install.packages(missing_cran)
}

if (!requireNamespace("langcog", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
  remotes::install_github("langcog/langcog")
}

require(knitr)
library(lme4)
library(ggeffects)
library(emmeans)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(langcog)

inport_dir <- here("data")

# set default code chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, warning = F, message = F)

# set default plot theme
theme_set(theme_classic() +
            theme(text = element_text(size = 18)))

# suppress warnings about grouping
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = F)
```

# Original Data

```{r}
# Load data in
df.e2adultfc_easy_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e2a_adultfc_easy.csv"))

df.e2adultfc_easy = as.data.frame(df.e2adultfc_easy_raw[which(df.e2adultfc_easy_raw$include == '1'),])

df.e2adultfc_easy_drop = as.data.frame(df.e2adultfc_easy_raw[which(df.e2adultfc_easy_raw$include == '0'),])

df.e2adultfc_hard_raw <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e2a_adultfc_hard.csv"))

df.e2adultfc_hard = as.data.frame(df.e2adultfc_hard_raw[which(df.e2adultfc_hard_raw$include == '1'),])

bind_rows(df.e2adultfc_easy_drop, df.e2adultfc_hard_drop) |>

df.e2adultfc_hard <- select(df.e2adultfc_hard,

                            InsR,
                            Sampling_Check1,
                            Sampling_Check2,
                            Age_Check1,

                            Number_TriCir,

                            Number_Vert,
                            Number_Horz,
                            Init_Horz,
                            Init_Vert,
                            TwoBlocks_TenBlocks,
                            Init_Distance,

                            Pattern_NoPattern,
                            Sampling,

# Selecting columns of interest in merged Data Frame
df.e2adultfc <- select(df.e2adultfc,
                           id,
                           condition,
                           age,
                           gender,
                           Number_TriCir,
                           Number_Cross,
                           Number_Vert,
                           Number_Horz,
                           Init_Horz,

# Reshape to long format and assign trial types
df.e2adultfc_long <- df.e2adultfc %>%
  gather(trial,correct,
        Number_TriCir,
        Number_Cross,
        Number_Vert,
        Number_Horz,
        Init_Horz,
        Init_Vert,
        TwoBlocks_TenBlocks,
        Pattern_NoPattern,
        Sampling,
        TwoPile_Castle,
        Vert_Horz,
        Adult_Child,
        Sling_TwoHands,
        OneAgent_TwoAgent) %>%
  rename(question_type = condition) %>%
  mutate(condition = ifelse(trial == "Number_TriCir"| trial == "Number_Cross"| trial == "Number_Vert" |trial == "Number_Horz" | trial == "TwoBlocks_TenBlocks" | trial == "TwoPile_Castle" | trial == "Vert_Horz", "Simple", ifelse(trial == "Sampling" | trial == "Pattern_NoPattern"| trial == "Init_Horz" | trial == "Init_Vert", "Complex", "Agent"))) %>%
  na.omit()
```

Change trial names:

```{r}
# Changing trial names to new format
df.e2adultfc_long <- df.e2adultfc_long |>
    mutate(trial = case_when(trial == "Number_TriCir" ~ "Number1",
                           trial == "Number_Cross" ~ "Number2",
                           trial == "Number_Vert" ~ "Number3",
                           trial == "Number_Horz" ~ "Number4",
                           trial == "Vert_Horz" ~ "Stability",
                           trial == "TwoBlocks_TenBlocks" ~ "Number&Stability",
                           trial == "Init_Horz" ~ "Process1",
                           trial == "Init_Vert" ~ "Process2",
                           trial == "Pattern_NoPattern" ~ "Pattern",
                           trial == "Sampling" ~ "Probability",
                           trial == "Sling_TwoHands" ~ "Agent1",
                           trial == "Adult_Child" ~ "Agent2",
                           trial == "OneAgent_TwoAgent" ~ "Agent3",
                           .default = trial))
```

# Replication Data (US Adults, Online, Pre-registered)

```{r}
TED_e2_rep_csv_files <- list.files(
  path       = here("data", "e2_adult_rep"),
  pattern    = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

TED_e2_rep_clean <- function(file_path) {
  dat <- readr::read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

  # the strategy and demographics answers are JSON strings in `response`
  strategy_raw <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "strategy_free_resp") %>%
    pull(response) %>%
    first(na_rm = TRUE)

  # per-participant values: the first non-missing entry in each column
  # (read_csv already reads blank cells as NA)
  participant_meta <- dat %>%
    summarise(
      source_file         = basename(file_path),
      condition           = first(condition, na_rm = TRUE),
      subject_id          = first(subject_id, na_rm = TRUE),
      study_id            = first(study_id, na_rm = TRUE),
      mic_access          = first(mic_access, na_rm = TRUE),
      mic_peak_volume     = first(peak_volume, na_rm = TRUE),
      strategy            = na_if(str_match(strategy_raw, '"strategy":"([^"]*)"')[, 2], ""),
      mic_time_to_pass_ms = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(first(time_to_pass_ms, na_rm = TRUE)))
    )

  # e2: main trials store the chosen stimulus id, not a numeric rating
  ratings_wide <- dat %>%
    filter(
      trial_type_custom == "main",
      !is.na(stimulus_id), stimulus_id != "",
      !is.na(chosen),      chosen != ""
    ) %>%
    transmute(stim_col = paste0("rating_", stimulus_id), chosen = chosen) %>%
    distinct(stim_col, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = stim_col, values_from = chosen)

  if (nrow(ratings_wide) == 0) ratings_wide <- tibble::tibble(.rows = 1)

  afc_wide <- tibble::tibble(.rows = 1)

  # attention checks are condition-dependent
  afc_checks_tbl <- dat %>%
    summarise(
      afc_check_house_correct = any(
        trial_type_custom == "check_house_triangle" & (
          (condition == "harder" & chosen == "house") |
          (condition == "easier" & chosen == "triangle")
        ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      afc_check_32_2_correct = any(
        trial_type_custom == "check_32" & chosen == "32_2",
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

  captcha_tbl <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "captcha") %>%
    summarise(captcha_passed = any(server_verified == "TRUE", na.rm = TRUE))

  rt_tbl <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "main") %>%
    mutate(rt_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(rt))) %>%
    summarise(
      any_fast_rt     = any(rt_num < 1000, na.rm = TRUE),
      all_same_rating = n_distinct(response, na.rm = TRUE) == 1
    )

  demographics_raw <- dat %>%
    filter(trial_type_custom == "demographics") %>%
    pull(response) %>%
    first(na_rm = TRUE)

  # pull each "field":"value" pair out of the JSON; blank answers become NA
  demographics_tbl <- tibble(
    age        = str_match(demographics_raw, '"age":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    language   = str_match(demographics_raw, '"language":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    ethnicity  = str_match(demographics_raw, '"ethnicity":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    gender     = str_match(demographics_raw, '"gender":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    colorblind = str_match(demographics_raw, '"colorblind":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    focus      = str_match(demographics_raw, '"focus":"([^"]*)"')[, 2],
    issues     = str_match(demographics_raw, '"issues":"([^"]*)"')[, 2]
  ) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~ na_if(.x, "")))

  bind_cols(participant_meta, ratings_wide, afc_wide, afc_checks_tbl, captcha_tbl, rt_tbl, demographics_tbl)
}

df.ted_e2_wide <- purrr::map_dfr(TED_e2_rep_csv_files, TED_e2_rep_clean)
```

Recode chosen stimulus by condition and apply exclusions:

```{r}
recode_harder_easier <- function(chosen_cell, cond) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(chosen_cell) | chosen_cell == "" ~ NA_real_,
    cond == "harder" & stringr::str_ends(chosen_cell, "_2_vertical") ~ 1,
    cond == "harder" ~ 0,
    cond == "easier" & stringr::str_ends(chosen_cell, "_2_vertical") ~ 0,
    cond == "easier" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )
}

df.ted_e2_wide_clean <- df.ted_e2_wide |>
  filter(
    afc_check_house_correct,
    afc_check_32_2_correct,
    mic_access == "TRUE",
    captcha_passed,
    !any_fast_rt,
    !all_same_rating,
    # colorblind: "yes" in any case, or "Red/Green"; blank (NA) is kept
    !(tolower(colorblind) %in% c("yes", "red/green")),
    !grepl("I noticed the difficulty and chose accordingly", strategy, fixed = TRUE)
  ) |>
  select(subject_id, condition, starts_with("rating_"), starts_with("afc_"),
         strategy, age, gender, ethnicity, colorblind, focus, issues) |>
  mutate(across(starts_with("rating_"), ~ recode_harder_easier(.x, condition)))

df.ted_e2_wide_clean |>
  group_by(condition) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n())
```

# Process Cleaned Data

```{r}

df.e2adultfc_rep <- df.ted_e2_wide_clean |>
  filter(afc_check_32_2_correct == TRUE)

# turn data long (one row per subject × rating trial)
df.e2adultfc_rep_long <- df.e2adultfc_rep %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("rating_"),
    names_to = "trial",
    names_prefix = "rating_",
    values_to = "correct"
  )

# map replication stimulus_id to the same trial names used in the original
# data, and harmonize condition labels ("easier"/"harder" -> "easy"/"hard")
df.e2adultfc_rep_trialnames <- read.csv(here(inport_dir, "e2_adult_rep_trialnames.csv")) |>
  mutate(stim_number = as.character(stim_number))

df.e2adultfc_rep_long <- df.e2adultfc_rep_long |>
  left_join(df.e2adultfc_rep_trialnames, by = c("trial" = "stim_number")) |>
  mutate(trial = trial_name,
         question_type = case_when(condition == "easier" ~ "easy",
                                    condition == "harder" ~ "hard",
                                    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  select(-trial_name)

```

# Demographic Information

```{r}

#number of participants
df.e2adultfc |>
  nrow()

#age
df.e2adultfc |>
  pull(age) |>
  mean(na.rm = T)

df.e2adultfc |>
  pull(age) |>
  sd(na.rm = T)

#1 = female, 0 = male
df.e2adultfc |>
  group_by(gender) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n())

```

Replication. Exclusions by reason: each participant is counted once, under the
first criterion they fail, in the order of the filter above.

```{r}

df.ted_e2_wide |>
  mutate(exclusion = case_when(
    !afc_check_house_correct | !afc_check_32_2_correct ~ "attention check",
    !(mic_access %in% "TRUE") ~ "microphone",
    !captcha_passed ~ "captcha",
    any_fast_rt ~ "fast RT",
    all_same_rating ~ "same response on all trials",
    tolower(colorblind) %in% c("yes", "red/green") ~ "colorblind",
    grepl("I noticed the difficulty and chose accordingly", strategy,
          fixed = TRUE) ~ "strategy",
    .default = "included")) |>
  count(condition, exclusion)

# age and gender are free-text in the export; blanks are NA
df.ted_e2_wide_clean |>
  mutate(age = as.numeric(age)) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n = n(),
                   n_female = sum(gender %in% "female"),
                   n_male = sum(gender %in% "male"),
                   n_other = sum(gender %in% "other"),
                   n_no_gender = sum(is.na(gender)),
                   n_reported_age = sum(!is.na(age)),
                   mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = T),
                   sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = T))

```

# Analyses


```{r}

df.e2adultfc_combined_long <- bind_rows(
  df.e2adultfc_long |>
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) |>
    select(id, trial, question_type, correct),
  df.e2adultfc_rep_long |>
    select(id = subject_id, trial, question_type, correct)
)

# Linear mixed effect model predictions
model_e2adultfc <- glmer(correct ~ 1 + trial + question_type + (1|id),
      data = df.e2adultfc_combined_long, family = "binomial",
      control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa",
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)))


# ggemmeans() rather than ggpredict(): ggpredict() would report the by-trial
# predictions at question_type == "easier" (its reference level) instead of
# averaging over both wordings. Matches the treatment in e2b.Rmd.
# ggemmeans() has no all-terms default, so each predictor is requested by name.
ggemmeans(model = model_e2adultfc, terms = "trial")
ggemmeans(model = model_e2adultfc, terms = "question_type")

```
